entities.summary: Krzysztof Lisek is a Polish politician. He was elected to the Sejm on 25 September 2005 getting 10,731 votes in 34 – Elbląg for Civic Platform. He served until 2009 when he was elected as a Member of the European Parliament, serving until 2014.
